newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE SEEN UP SLIGHTLY, OVERALL TREND FLAT.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE SEEN UP SLIGHTLY, OVERALL TREND FLAT.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rise slightly in low pre-holiday trade, maintaining their general flat trend begun in early November.
Analysts said the main market, currently at 13,851.9 points, could approach 14,000 points by year-end.
But they said Polifarb Cieszyn and Polifarb Wroclaw could achieve significant gains after the two firms announced late Wednesday they sought to merge.
Analysts said Swarzedz could extend Thursday's 9.7-percent gain after it signed a 200-million-mark contract.
